name: Lean 4
typeSystem: Dependent types, Calculus of Constructions with inductive types
runtime: Compiled to C via reference counting (no GC), or interpreted

codeExample.source:
def factorial : Nat → Nat
  | 0     => 1
  | n + 1 => (n + 1) * factorial n

theorem factorial_pos : ∀ n, factorial n > 0 := by
  intro n; induction n with
  | zero => simp [factorial]
  | succ n ih => simp [factorial]; omega
